existing_rows_audit.detail: Millennium's own global presence page (https://www.mlp.com/global-presence/) lists its Swiss offices as Zug and Geneva - Zurich is not listed, and the careers portal has zero Zurich listings across all 248 live reqs. The existing row's claim of "four Swiss offices" is also unsupported. If the candidate wants a Swiss Millennium seat, the real cities are Geneva (quant/pricing library work is referenced in the London FICT and Treasury reqs) and Zug.

The Paris office is real and confirmed on https://www.mlp.com/global-presence/, but the only live Paris req on the careers portal is "Receptionist and Travel & Expenses Coordinator" (https://career.mlp.com/careers/job/755956787747). There is no Quantitative Developer or any other in-scope-track role open in Paris as of 2026-08-04.

The Tokyo office is real and confirmed on the global presence page, but the only two live Tokyo reqs are "Java Algo Developer - Algo Development Technology" (https://career.mlp.com/careers/job/755955637002) and "End User Services Support Engineer". No role titled Quantitative Developer is open in Tokyo. Two other reqs do list Tokyo as an acceptable basing though: Quantitative Researcher, Equity (REQ-25302) and Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Strategies (REQ-29970).

The London office is real and by far the largest in-scope one (45 live reqs), but Millennium does not use the title "Core Platform Engineer" anywhere on its careers portal. The equivalent live London seats are "Quantitative Developer/Trading Systems Engineer, Systematic Macro" (https://career.mlp.com/careers/job/755957629966, C++, 5+ yrs) and "Software Engineer - Java" (https://career.mlp.com/careers/job/755957542118, up to 3 yrs). The row's requirement bullets ("Strong modern C++ 14/17/20", "No finance background required") do not correspond to any actual Millennium posting.

Out of scope for this pass (US), so not researched. Flagging only that the title "Core Platform Engineer" does not appear anywhere on Millennium's careers portal in any location, so this row is likely mistitled in the same way as the London row.

notes:
Primary source: Millennium's careers portal is Eightfold-hosted and reachable at both https://career.mlp.com/careers and https://mlp.eightfold.ai/careers. I enumerated the full live req list via the portal's own JSON API (248 total reqs, 246 retrieved - 2 lost to pagination) and read each in-scope posting in full. Live location breakdown of in-scope cities on 2026-08-04: London 45, Hong Kong 23, Singapore 12, Dublin 9, Tokyo 2, Paris 1 (receptionist, out of scope). Out-of-scope offices with heavy hiring: New York 76, Bangalore 52, Miami 11.

Offices: confirmed against https://www.mlp.com/global-presence/. In-scope cities the firm actually has are London, Dublin, Paris, Geneva, Zug, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. There is NO Zurich, Shanghai, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Milan or Warsaw office. Geneva and Zug are confirmed offices but had zero live reqs on the portal - Geneva quant staff are referenced inside the London FICT and Treasury postings, so the seat is real but not currently advertised. One req (REQ-29970) names Shanghai as a preferred location despite no Shanghai office being listed; treat that as unconfirmed.

Application mechanics worth knowing: several front-office quant reqs bypass the portal entirely and instruct candidates to email a regional mailbox with the REQ number as the subject - QuantTalentEUR@mlp.com, QuantTalentASIA@mlp.com, QuantTalentUS@mlp.com. Two of those reqs point at the wrong regional mailbox relative to their stated location, so mirroring the application to the geographically correct mailbox is sensible. Portfolio manager candidates go to PMCandidates@mlp.com.

Experience-gate pattern: Millennium is hiring almost entirely at 2+ to 8+ years across in-scope offices. Only two in-scope reqs are genuinely open at this candidate's ~18-month level - London "Software Engineer - Java" (up to 3 years, explicitly welcomes strong recent graduates) and Hong Kong "Quantitative Researcher" REQ-29559 (no experience floor at all). All three Dublin quant reqs state 6+ years. No student-gated or graduating-in-year reqs were found among the in-scope roles; Millennium's campus programme lives separately at https://www.mlp.com/careers/students/ and was not enumerated since the candidate is no longer a student.

Compensation: no in-scope posting stated a salary figure, and Ireland/UK/APAC postings on this portal carry no pay ranges. All comp_local fields are therefore left empty rather than estimated. The USD figures in the existing spreadsheet rows are not traceable to any Millennium source I could find.

Coverage gaps: 2 of 248 reqs were not retrieved due to API pagination and could theoretically be in-scope. Roles whose primary language is Java or kdb+/q are labelled track "C++" because that is the nearest of the four permitted tracks; the notes field flags the actual stack in each case. Data engineering and data-science reqs in Hong Kong (Systematic Data Group) were read but excluded as out of scope per the brief.
